card.name: The word individual in dosing text
card.fires_on: The word "individual" (or its start, as in "individualized") in dosing instructions, mainly after "Dosage must be" or "should be". It also fires on "any individual patient" and on the start of "INDIVIDUALS".

modes.label: Dosage individualized
modes.description: "individual" begins "individualized" after a phrase saying dosage must or should be adjusted.
modes.example: Dosage must be<< individual>>ized in each case.

modes.label: Individual as a person
modes.description: "individual" or "INDIVIDUALS" refers to a single patient or person.
